exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 101 singleton, very preterm infants (23-29 weeks gestation)
finding: While univariate analyses showed gestational age, birth weight, and mode of delivery as significant predictors of survival in very preterm infants, only gestational age remained statistically significant in multivariate analysis.
mod_finding: While cesarean section was associated with higher survival in univariate analysis, it was not statistically significant in the multivariate model.
